verdict.rationale: The channel docs point to inbound access control: the WhatsApp page covers "access controls" (openclaw-docs-104) and the Telegram page "sets who is all[owed]" to use the bot (openclaw-docs-105). Telegram and Discord are documented across both DMs and groups/guilds (openclaw-docs-62, openclaw-docs-63). These snippets only hint at gating, though, and give no concrete mechanics. Missing for 10: explicit sender allowlist configuration, documented DM policy modes, mention gating for groups and channels, consistent gating across all channels, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
